purpose: Independently read the actual original-maintenance receipt and retained native setup/probe/rollback records after the managed-health failure; do not infer rollback or later completion from reaching a call stack.

implementation.execution: Existing Ubuntu 24.04 isolated stdlib-only inert artifact reader; no extraction, archive imports, application imports, payload execution or result relabelling.
implementation.scope: Only the standard-update evidence directory, fixed requested basenames and native-managed-*.log. Missing requested records are printed explicitly.
changes: Bind exact run, source, artifact, size and SHA256 before reading.
Retain existing bounded ZIP inventory/member guard.
Print exact member byte counts and SHA256; decode UTF-16 BOM native logs without interpreting them.
